topic: E-130J design-review execution and delivery state
public_statement: FY2027 Navy BA5 preserved a revised schedule but did not provide proposition-level PDR completion evidence.
internal_content: PB2027 MSAR records IBR conduct/closure and AV1 configuration PDR on March 31-April 1, 2026, keeps full-system/final weapon-system PDR estimated for July 2026 with no actual date, and reports zero delivered E-130J development/procurement end items.
notes: AV1 PDR and IBR are completed execution events. Full-system PDR remains unresolved; zero-delivery applies only to the MSAR observation state.
